content.passage: It’s 6 o'clock in the morning. I'm getting up. Where's Dad ? He's in the kitchen! He's having his tea. It’s 7 am. We're having our breakfast. My dad is putting on his jacket. He's putting on his shoes and he's picking up his bag. Why is he going out ? My dad is a doctor. He works at the hospital. He starts work at 8 o'clock in the morning! It’s 5 pm. We're watching TV now. What is Dad doing ? Dad is working. He's helping people. It’s 9 pm. I'm going to bed. Goodnight!

items.notes: Transcribed from the source book; teacher verification required.
